title: Megrez: A Knowledge-Guided Agent for Formal Mathematics over MK Set Theory
abstract: arXiv:2611.13613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General-purpose coding agents equipped with proof-assistant tools have shown strong performance on standalone competition problems, yet cumulative textbook formalization inside a low-resource mathematical library still faces three obstacles: aligning textbook concepts with library declarations, keeping long-horizon search synchronized with live proof states, and integrating locally verified proofs reliably into a growing codebase. We present Megrez, a knowledge-guided formalization agent for Rocq libraries built on Morse--Kelley (MK) set theory. translated_title: Megrez：基于MK集合论的面向形式化数学的知识引导智能体
translated_abstract: 配备证明助手工具的通用编码智能体在独立的竞赛题目上已经表现出强劲性能，但在低资源数学库中进行累积性的教材形式化时，仍然面临三大障碍：将教材概念与库中的声明对齐、使长程搜索与实时证明状态保持同步，以及将局部验证过的证明可靠地集成到不断增长的代码库中。我们提出了Megrez，一个基于Morse-Kelley（MK）集合论构建的、面向Rocq数学库的知识引导形式化智能体。Megrez通过三个机制来协调通用编码智能体：(1) 一个可从源码重建的知识图谱，它合并了形式化声明、编译器引用和人工整理的元数据，以支持通过中文别名、概念簇、证明依赖和多通道全文排序进行检索；(2) 一个由反馈驱动的1-5条战术短程证明循环，配合目标局部分支账本和（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: Megrez提出了一个基于MK集合论的知识引导形式化智能体，通过可重建知识图谱、反馈驱动的短程证明循环等三项机制，解决了在低资源数学库中进行累积性教材形式化时的概念对齐、长程搜索同步和证明集成三大难题。
en_tdlr: Megrez introduces a knowledge-guided formalization agent over MK set theory that addresses three key obstacles in cumulative textbook formalization of low-resource mathematical libraries—concept alignment, long-horizon search synchronization, and reliable proof integration—through three mechanisms including a source-rebuildable knowledge graph and a feedback-driven short-burst proving loop.
